text:
Hi,

I wanted to share an update and also ask if this is normal procedure.

We had our visa renewal meeting today. We came fully prepared with all the required documents, but when we arrived, we were told on the spot that there would be no interview today. Instead, the interview has been postponed until September this year.

In the meantime, my visa (B1) was only extended for four months (until September), rather than for a full year. The clerk told us that this is completely normal and that it’s common to have two meetings a year with Misrad Hapnim, with shorter visa extensions in between.

This caught us a bit by surprise, so I wanted to check - is this indeed standard procedure? Also our documents weren't checked and couldn't be uploaded beforehand on their platform.

Thanks in advance for your guidance!
